text:
The CS stage with a PMOS current-source load is the right move. The failing spec is swing: 1.294 V simulated against 1.5 V needed. The PMOS gate is tied to vin = 0.75 V, so it runs at gm/Id ≈ 7 with Vdsat ≈ 0.24 V, which limits the upper swing. Tuning the current parameters barely moves swing: none shifts it by more than 0.02% for a +10% change.

The new program runs the PMOS as a load biased from the ibias diode node. That puts it at low overdrive with Vdsat around 0.12 V. The NMOS supplies all the gm and Rf sets the bandwidth. The power budget is tight: about 67 µA for the main branch after the 10 µA reference.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Swing is limited by PMOS Vdsat (gate fixed at vin, gm/Id≈7). Switch to NMOS CS with low-overdrive PMOS load biased from the ibias diode (no extra branch); NMOS supplies all gm, Rf sets bandwidth; Wp is solved for a target vout."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Wn":   (9.5,  4.0,  20.0),    # NMOS driver width [um]
    "Ln":   (0.18, 0.15, 0.4),     # NMOS length [um]
    "Lp":   (0.5,  0.25, 1.0),     # PMOS load length [um]
    "vt":   (0.85, 0.75, 1.0),     # target vout_dc used to solve Wp [V]
    "Rf":   (10e3, 5e3,  30e3),    # resistor vout->vin [ohm] (sets f3db)
    "Wb":   (1.0,  0.5,  4.0),     # ibias diode width [um] (sets PMOS vsg)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Wn, Ln, Lp, Rf, Wb = p["Wn"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["Rf"], p["Wb"]
    Lb = 1.0

    # ibias diode voltage (gate bias for PMOS load)
    lo, hi = 0.3, 1.5
    for _ in range(50):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op("n", Wb, Lb, mid, mid)["Id"] > iref:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    vb = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    vsg_p = VDD - vb

    # size PMOS so KCL holds at vout = vt
    vt = p["vt"]
    In_t = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vt)["Id"]
    Ip_need = In_t + (vt - vin) / Rf
    Ip_unit = lut.op("p", 1.0, Lp, vsg_p, VDD - vt)["Id"]
    Wp = max(0.42, min(400.0, Ip_need / max(Ip_unit, 1e-12)))

    def kcl(v):
        In = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, v)["Id"]
        Ip = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_p, VDD - v)["Id"]
        return Ip - In - (v - vin) / Rf

    lo, hi = 0.02, VDD - 0.02
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if kcl(mid) > 0:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    vout = 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout)
    op_ = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_p, VDD - vout)
    G = 1.0 / Rf
    gm = on["gm"]
    gds = on["gds"] + op_["gds"]
    gain = (gm - G) / (gds + G)
    cpar = 0.35 * on["cgg"] + 0.3 * op_["cgg"]
    ctot = cl + cpar
    f3db = (gds + G) / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = gain * f3db
    power = VDD * (op_["Id"] + iref)
    swing = VDD - max(on["vdsat"], 0.08) - max(op_["vdsat"], 0.08) - 0.05

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("MP1", "vout", "ibias", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "vin", Rf)
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Lb)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(max(gain, 1e-6)),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
